author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
In this video, you’ll learn how to streamline document review processes using Adobe Acrobat Studio and its AI-powered PDF Spaces feature. See how to bring files, feedback, and collaborators into one shared workspace where you can manage documents, track comments, and use AI to analyze and summarize content—all in one place. 

If you’ve ever tried to review a document with multiple stakeholders, you know how quickly it can become overwhelming keeping track of comments in emails, different file versions, and feedback scattered across platforms. Managing changes, decisions, and the latest version can slow everything down. 

You’ll see how to: 
- Create a PDF Space for document review and collaboration 
- Add files and consolidate feedback in a single workspace 
- Use AI Assistant to identify outdated content and summarize changes 
- Create a custom AI persona for specialized document analysis 
- Save insights and action items as structured notes 
- Share PDF Spaces with stakeholders and
title: Adobe Acrobat Studio: One of the Best Platforms for Streamlining Document Review Processes (2026)
